limits: Native Canvas renders execute the real FightEngine; these are not browser screenshots. DOM, CSS, browser input, browser decoding and service worker are not tested.

PNG files are read unchanged through the source HTTP server and verified by SHA-256. Sharp normalizes PNG encoding only in memory for native Canvas compatibility; complete decoded pixel equality is checked. Original files remain unchanged.
Minimal adapters provide storage/events and absence of gamepads. Real engine intros, updates, render and pause are used; actor positions, facing, health and poses are never manually overridden.
Left-facing display is the engine mirror, not independently established opposite-side source anatomy. Static idle candidates do not certify source animation or 1:1 fidelity.
This harness writes only QA reports and rendered screenshots; it does not rebuild manifests or modify registry, artwork, rules or engine code.

visualReview.method: All six tick120 images opened through view_image at native 1280x720.
observations: Mama and Split Worm fit entirely in both slots; the long tail, long fingertips and pointed leg ends are present within the viewport.
Fighter and Red Pyramid Thing face one another in both slot orders. Both feet and the full Great Knife blade remain visible.
Brawler and Agile face inward; fists, forward knife, feet and head contours remain visible without portrait substitution.
Every tested pair keeps visible support ends near the drawn arena ground/shadow level; no corrective anchor change was required.
No opaque bitmap rectangles or obvious clipping are visible in the inspected engine captures.
limits: Idle-only visual scenes do not validate attacks, contacts, collisions, animation timing or original source scale.
HUD and background are the existing game; no UI redesign was tested.
Opposite slots use the current runtime mirroring policy.
